description: Build a static dependency map for a module, file, or package showing all inbound and outbound imports, flagging circular references, tight coupling, god-modules, and orphaned code. It reads the import graph and runs nothing. Use when the user asks "what depends on this file", "can I delete this safely", or "what imports this module". To prove a change is safe by running code, use blast-radius. Not a runtime execution trace — use explain-flow when the user wants to know how a request flows through the system rather than which files import which.
